scope: Repository-local review of README, member guide draft, portal member texts and the current checkout of Wave 4/dev-stack evidence. External upstream product claims were not reverified.

findings.resolved_in: docs/handover/member-guide.md (Part I zh-TW §3.2 and Part II en §3.2)
findings.claim: Guarantees no local ISP fallback when the tunnel fails.
findings.actual: Spec §7.3 and portal member.gettingStarted.killSwitchWarningBody explicitly exclude a complete client kill switch. Server-side fail closed is not endpoint routing protection.
findings.requested_change: Replace the guarantee with the portal limitation; record disconnect, sleep and network-switch behavior per platform.

findings.resolved_in: docs/handover/member-guide.md (Part I zh-TW §2.2 A–D and Part II en §2.2 A–D)
findings.claim: Tells members to click Authorize Device in the portal.
findings.actual: MemberDevicesPage implements list and revoke only. The 41-endpoint contract has no member authorize command; authorization is a central entitlement/device-sync action (§7.3).
findings.requested_change: Describe automatic central authorization and pending/authorized status; do not invent a button or endpoint.

findings.resolved_in: docs/handover/member-guide.md (Part I zh-TW §3.2, §4 and Part II en §3.2, §4)
findings.claim: Promises forwarding off within 30 seconds on disable/switch and describes immediate revocation.
findings.actual: §16.3 uses the earliest lease/service deadline; §16.5 online revocation target starts at 60 seconds and is not an offline guarantee. Prior lease-expiry run had no serving flow.
findings.requested_change: Distinguish watchdog staleness from online revocation and offline deadline; label timings unmeasured until AT29 runs.

findings.resolved_in: docs/handover/member-guide.md (Part I zh-TW §1, §2.2C, §3.1, §3.3 and Part II en §1, §2.2C, §3.1, §3.3)
findings.claim: Calls native versions verified and Linux checks Verified on dev/test stack; tells iOS users to install build 2 from App Store.
findings.actual: docs/netbird/VERSIONS.md labels all native candidates needs measurement and describes iOS build 2 as TestFlight with App Store availability unasserted. The current checkout has no matching four-platform evidence.
findings.requested_change: Use candidate versions and needs operator run; link dated evidence only after actual device runs.

findings.resolved_in: docs/handover/member-guide.md (Part I zh-TW §3.1 and Part II en §3.1)
findings.section: 3.1 (zh-TW exit-IP claim and both language commands)
findings.claim: Uses GET /member/me to verify exit IP and a bare curl to an authenticated endpoint.
findings.actual: The response is account/entitlement information, not an egress reflection. No session cookie is supplied. A failed ping alone also lacks a reachable control test.
findings.requested_change: Use the controlled lab origin observed source IP with a positive reachability control; use a protected session config for authenticated API reads.

findings.resolved_in: docs/handover/member-guide.md (Part I zh-TW §6.1 and Part II en §6.1)
findings.claim: Claims all port-53 traffic is DNAT redirected to two fixed overlay resolvers.
findings.actual: RenderServing allows configured resolver addresses but has no DNS DNAT; arbitrary external DNS handling is a selected policy decision in §12.6. The guide presents example addresses as operational guarantees.
findings.requested_change: Describe configured resolver use and the measured external-DNS policy, remove unsupported universal interception.

findings.resolved_in: docs/handover/member-guide.md (Part I zh-TW §6.2 and Part II en §6.2)
findings.claim: Equates DoT with DNS carried over HTTPS port 443.
findings.actual: §12.6 distinguishes DoT/DoQ from DoH over ordinary HTTPS; portal copy groups bypass cases without this transport equivalence.
findings.requested_change: Separate protocols and state that actual behavior depends on selected policy and platform.

findings.resolved_in: docs/handover/member-guide.md (Part I zh-TW §7.2 and Part II en §7.2)
findings.claim: Promises allow overrides take effect for every member within 60 seconds because blocked_ttl_seconds=60.
findings.actual: §12.5–12.6 includes publication/ACK, resolver caches, app caches and existing connections; TTL is configurable and is not an end-to-end SLA.
findings.requested_change: State configured TTL and measured publication delay separately; remove universal 60-second promise.

findings.claim: Describes absolute isolation, working ledger/shaping and signed fleet rollback in the present tense.
findings.actual: README already says early development, but prior published run records still block forwarding, usage and update-good. The feature list does not identify these acceptance gaps.
findings.requested_change: Label intended capabilities and link the acceptance matrix; qualify absolute host/LAN reachability claims by the supported server path.

findings.resolved_in: docs/handover/member-guide.md (Part I zh-TW §5.1 and Part II en §5.1)
findings.claim: Describes admitted IPv4/IPv6 bytes without saying IPv6 forwarding is blocked in v1.
findings.actual: node/enforce only implements IPv6Block and the renderer drops member IPv6. No supported IPv6 Internet path is established.
findings.requested_change: State the current IPv6-block mode and distinguish the ledger format from available forwarding.

findings.resolved_in: docs/handover/member-guide.md (Part I zh-TW §5.3 and Part II en §5.3)
findings.claim: Treats minimum_rate as a guaranteed delivered bandwidth floor and never-disconnect promise.
findings.actual: §11.5–11.7 require a usable configured shaping floor, not unlimited delivered throughput; lease, isolation, meter or storage failure still stops forwarding.
findings.requested_change: Describe the configured floor and shared-capacity limits; retain mandatory fail-closed exceptions.

findings.claim: Column label says allocated address / Peer ID.
findings.actual: The cell renders dev.device_id, an internal UUID, rather than an overlay address or peer ID.
findings.requested_change: Relabel as device ID or render contract-supported observed peer information; keep implementation details out of member guidance.

findings.resolved_in: docs/handover/member-guide.md (all sections in Part I zh-TW and Part II en, plus aligned citations in docs/handover/{README,deploy,calibration,restore-drill,operator-guide}.md)
findings.claim: Uses §7.5, ISO03/ISO04, AT03 for revoke, AT18 for UTC reset, and AT17 for tiering.
findings.actual: The authoritative spec has §7.1–7.3 and ISO01/ISO02; AT03 is payments, AT18 is combined shaping, AT17 is month/late/quality and AT19 is tiers/reset.
findings.requested_change: Audit section and requirement references against the actual catalogue; map the guide to AT01/02/04/09/19/21/29 as appropriate.

unified_model_review.result: component test only; physical source comparison needs operator run
notes documented as metadata; no full runtime source/notes authorization comparison claimed
